sourceSentences: [0] Syndra's E stun is the entire lane. If it hits, you lose the trade. She only threatens when E connects with a Q sphere. Don't stand between her and a sphere.
[0] Trade hard after E is used since she has no way to stun you.
[0] At level six, stay high HP as more spheres mean more damage and she can one shot you.
[0] Respect the gold card since it's guaranteed Q and empowered auto. His Q is easy to dodge on its own. Stay away from minions when he has a red card since it will splash onto you.
[0] At level six, spam ping that he has R and don't follow. Push the wave instead.
[1] Very easy lane, You can dodge his Q and constantly harass him, poke him. Save your E for when he decides to pull out his gold card, so he can't get near you.
[1] The big issue you need to watch out for with Twisted Fate is his gold card since the stun can potentially lead to you taking damage from an entire combo string and dying.
